name: Ramkvilla - Asa
description: Ramkvilla to Asa. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Public HÖ10 pages are under Jönköpings län, but official narrative and endpoint/POI records show the section crosses into Kronoberg/Växjö near Asa.
Feresjön objects appear in Kronoberg/Växjö geography but some official records list Vetlanda kommun as contact/organization.
Research inventory treats HÖ10 as part of the main loop, while public route pages/API expose HÖ10 as a point-to-point stage from Ramkvilla to Asa.
API length is 0.2 km while description says 240 m to the rest area.
Smålandsleden brand-page GPX-style target and direct .gpx/.geojson/.kml variants did not provide usable geometry; the locale Naturkartan GPX works.
OSM relation 15419729 covers Ramkvilla-Asa-Sävsjö rather than HÖ10 only, has a 54 km tag but 75.796 km computed length, reverse member order and Asa-side divergence from official GPX.

facilities.name: Ramkvilla ledentré HÖ9/HÖ10
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ9/HÖ10 entrance at the sports field in Ramkvilla. Official text says parking and a grocery store are nearby. Shared endpoint with HÖ9. No public drinking-water claim.

facilities.name: Ramkvilla Camping / golf club camping
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 2958198658 and Ramkvilla/Ramkvilla Golf service pages
facilities.description: Commercial camping/ställplats by Ramkvilla with service-building facilities such as shower, toilet, kitchen, laundry and latrine disposal; café/kiosk nearby when open. Water/service availability is paid, seasonal or customer-linked; do not model as free public trail water without confirmation.

facilities.name: Klockesjöbadet / Ramkvilla badplats
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 8766402683; Vetlanda municipal bathing-place source confirms facility context
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place near the Ramkvilla start. Facilities lane found a contradiction with third-party bath pages: Vetlanda municipal source says no toilet/no grill, so prefer municipal data. Bathing water is not drinking water.

facilities.name: ICA Nära Puttes Lanthandel
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM way 157957034 center; ICA official page for service identity
facilities.description: Ramkvilla grocery and service point. ICA page lists services such as pharmacy agent, fuel, parcel agents and Systembolaget agent. Retail bottled water only unless later verified otherwise. Facilities lane found OSM opening-hour differences; use ICA official page for hours.

facilities.name: Ramoa Adventure Village / Café Mangelboden
facilities.coordinateSource: Ställplatsappen and OSM café nearby; Naturkartan API neighbor 128236 corroborates route proximity
facilities.description: Commercial adventure/lodging/camping and cafe-service context close to HÖ10 near km 2. Fresh water listed by camping/ställplats source, but access is paid/customer-linked. Local pages differ on spontaneous cafe access versus prebooking; mark food availability pending.

facilities.name: Avstickare Feresjön (vindskydd)
facilities.description: Official side trail from HÖ10 to the Feresjön rest area. API length is 0.2 km and official description says 240 m to the facilities. Model as side/access metadata, not as a separate facility or part of HÖ10 main geometry.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Höglandsleden, Feresjön
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan/Smålandsleden marker; OSM confirms shelter context
facilities.description: Official shelter at Feresjön reached by a short side trail from HÖ10. Official attributes include shelter, dry toilet, sack rack/waste handling, fireplace and picnic table. Direct distance is about 183 m and the official spur is about 240 m. No potable water; lake water must be treated/boiled if used. Firewood is not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Dass, Höglandsleden Feresjön
facilities.description: Official dry toilet at the Feresjön rest area. Access is via Feresjön side trail. Current condition should be field-checked before high-confidence trip guidance.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Feresjön
facilities.description: Official Feresjön fireplace/grill area. Official attributes include nearby shelter, toilet, table, seating, near water and bin; no grate/charcoal. Use only if live fire-risk/fire-ban rules allow. Bring your own firewood.

facilities.name: Feresjön rest area picnic/waste context
facilities.coordinateSource: Shelter/rest-area page and Feresjön facility cluster
facilities.description: Picnic table and waste/sack-rack context at the Feresjön rest area. Normalize with shelter/fireplace/toilet to avoid duplicate POI clutter. Wording varies between sack rack and bin.

facilities.name: Asa ledentré HÖ10/HÖ11
facilities.description: Official shared HÖ10/HÖ11 entrance at Asa. Also connects to Sigfridsleden toward Växjö. Shared endpoint with HÖ11 and Sigfridsleden connection. Ledentré page does not directly list parking or water.

facilities.name: Asa area services
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan Asa area object; endpoint area approximation
facilities.description: Area-level Asa context with several parking options nearby and service/lodging starts such as Asa Herrgård and Asa Vandrarhem. Do not import this as a single precise facility; use to support exact Asa service records and parking verification.

facilities.name: Asa Vandrarhem
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 5035982675 and Asa Vandrarhem site
facilities.description: Commercial hostel/lodging in Asa with guest kitchen, showers and toilets. Water and toilet/shower access are for guests/customers, not public trail facilities.

facilities.name: Asa Herrgård
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 5035982746 and Asa Herrgård/Naturkartan Asa context
facilities.description: Commercial lodging/restaurant context near the Asa endpoint. Official narrative notes Asa herrgård in the southwest part of the route area. Commercial/customer service; do not model water as public.

facilities.name: Asa badplats
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan marker; OSM nearby toilet/parking corroboration
facilities.description: Bathing place near Asa with dry toilet/parking/dock/waste/picnic context from Naturkartan and OSM corroboration. No drinking water identified; bathing water is not potable.
